summary.text: 新华社: the Dow rose 0.02% to 52867.98, the S&P 500 fell 1.21% to 7663.43, and the Nasdaq fell 2.60% to 26008.859. 华尔街见闻: the Nasdaq print was 26008.86, its worst day since June, and the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 6.72%.

themeCards.title: Meta's spending promise grew and the Nasdaq had its worst day since June
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：纳指跌2.60%报26008.86点，费城半导体指数跌6.72%。 律动：Meta未来支出承诺升至8250亿美元，五年期信用违约互换报价创纪录新高，股价收跌6.98%。
themeCards.mechanism: The selloff is the market demanding proof that a larger spending promise can be funded. CICC (12 October): operating cash flow at the large US AI firms is already near capital spending, so the build draws on equity and debt. US equities and credit carry the 8250亿美元 promise, the 2.60% Nasdaq drop, and the 6.98% Meta drop. The theme changes if that promise is cut or the credit gauge leaves its record.
themeCards.trigger: A future spending promise of 8250亿美元, a record credit gauge, and a 2.60% Nasdaq drop.
themeCards.invalidator: The spending promise is cut or the credit gauge leaves its record.

themeCards.title: Treasuries had their biggest daily gain in over a year
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：10年期收益率跌约18个基点至4.965%，一个月来首次跌破5%，2年期跌至4.65%。 财经早茶：避险需求推动美国国债创下逾一年来最大单日涨幅。
themeCards.mechanism: The bond rally is a rush into Treasuries on a day equities and credit were sold, and it took the 10-year back under 5%. CICC (10 June): higher oil can pass into core inflation and lift longer-run inflation expectations, and heavy government borrowing still asks investors for extra compensation. Treasuries carry the 4.965% yield. The theme changes if the 10-year yield moves back to 5% or higher.
themeCards.trigger: A 10-year yield of 4.965% after the biggest daily Treasury gain in over a year.
themeCards.invalidator: The 10-year yield moves back to 5% or higher.

themeCards.title: The France-Germany spread hit the widest since the 2011 crisis
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：法国10年期国债收益率盘中升破5%，法德利差一度扩大至175个基点，为2011年欧债危机以来最高。
themeCards.mechanism: A France-Germany gap at the 2011 crisis wide point is a budget premium that widened again. CICC (12 October): the 2027 budget can still pass, but the fiscal adjustment that survives decides how far this premium comes back. OATs carry the 175bp gap and the move through 5%. The theme changes if the France-Germany spread falls back below 175bp.
themeCards.trigger: A France-Germany spread of 175bp, the widest since the 2011 crisis.
themeCards.invalidator: The France-Germany spread falls back below 175bp.

themeCards.title: Oil jumped after attacks on Saudi facilities
themeCards.fact: 华尔街见闻：WTI 12月合约涨2.39%报99.47美元/桶，布伦特12月合约涨4.00%报113.17美元/桶。 见闻称胡塞武装袭击沙特设施，且美以已制定中期选举后打击伊朗的计划。
themeCards.mechanism: Attacks on Saudi facilities and a plan for another strike after the US midterms are why the oil book jumped. CICC (14 September): low inventories make a near-term price move more elastic when Strait traffic tightens. Oil carries the 99.47 and 113.17 settles. The theme changes if those attacks stop and Brent settles below 113.17.
themeCards.trigger: WTI at 99.47 and Brent at 113.17, with attacks on Saudi facilities and a reported post-election strike plan.
themeCards.invalidator: Attacks on Saudi facilities stop and Brent settles below 113.17.

globalRegime: Thursday's tape was a flight out of the AI spending trade into Treasuries, while oil rose on attacks in Saudi Arabia and French bonds widened further. Asia equities fell with the chip complex. The chart is panda-bond issuance already above last year's full-year total. Labor claims fell to a three-month low on the same day the Nasdaq had its worst session since June.

globalChanged.text: 财经早茶：随着避险需求升温，美国国债创下逾一年来最大单日涨幅，10年期收益率重回5%下方。
财经早茶：DoubleLine副首席投资官继续看空长期美债，认为暂时的反弹不代表基本面改变。
财经早茶：SK海力士旗下闪存业务Solidigm放弃美国IPO计划。10月势将成为今年美国IPO募资额最少的一个月。黑石总裁反驳人工智能泡沫论，称需求呈抛物线式增长。
财经早茶：特朗普表示将暂不以国家安全为由对风力涡轮机及其零部件加征关税，允许180天时间进行谈判。
财经早茶：法国资产普遍承压，法债相对德债的收益率溢价达到15年来最高，比肩欧债危机时期。法国周末可能再度爆发抗议活动。
财经早茶：美国首次申领失业救济人数降至三个月低点，显示劳动力市场保持稳定。
财经早茶：莫德纳和默克股价重挫，两家公司共同研发的黑色素瘤疫苗实验数据未达到华尔街的高预期。
财经早茶：特朗普援引国防生产法以扩大石油产能，并签署行政令，指示联邦住房金融局设立试点，取消部分贷款的抵押贷款保险要求。
财经早茶：美国财政部拟禁止持有大量住房的大型机构投资者继续购买独栋住宅。
财经早茶：巴西周日将举行总统选举第二轮投票，财经早茶称两位候选人的民调打成平手。
财经早茶：加拿大据悉严格限制驻美外交官接触中期选举候选人，以免遭到政治干预指控。
华尔街见闻：截至10月17日当周，美国首次申请失业救济人数降至19.4万，低于预期的20万。韩国央行维持基准利率3.00%不变。
华尔街见闻：胡塞武装称袭击沙特国防部与沙特阿美设施，并称美以已制定中期选举后对伊朗的打击计划。

globalImplies.text: If attacks on Saudi facilities continue, the oil book can stay above the 113.17 Brent settle.
If the 10-year yield moves back to 5% or higher, Thursday's Treasury rally was a shelter bid on a day equities were sold.
If the France-Germany spread stays at 175bp, OATs hold a budget premium into today's sovereign review.

globalTensions: The Dow rose 0.02% while the Nasdaq fell 2.60%. Treasuries rallied to a 4.965% 10-year yield while the France-Germany spread widened to 175bp. Brent rose to 113.17 while the breakfast said gold fell. Initial claims fell to 19.4万, below the 20万 estimate, on the day the Nasdaq had its worst session since June.
chinaStance: Beijing published new outbound-investment rules that take effect on 1 December, and the commerce ministry said export controls and security reviews will be filled in over the next five-year plan. Washington is preparing limits on US investment in Chinese biotech and brain-computer firms. Fund houses announced active-ETF subscriptions into the equity drop. Offshore yuan firmed on the breakfast tape. The quake response is a disaster operation, and LPR was not revisited.

chinaChanged.text: 财经早茶：中国发布对外投资管理办法，自12月1日起施行。发改委称新办法完善了境外再投资报告等制度。商务部表示，十五五时期将完善出口管制和安全审查机制。
财经早茶：特朗普政府拟限制美国投资中国生物技术企业和脑机接口公司。
财经早茶：力拓与中国矿产资源集团据悉就铁矿石供应达成多年期协议，合同期从今年11月持续至2028年5月。
财经早茶：央视微信公众号玉渊谭天称，DeepSeek和MiniMax已履行登记手续，完成开源和海外授权使用。
财经早茶：受中国市场疲软拖累，Gucci和爱马仕上季度营收逊于预期，普拉达营收增长也受到影响。
财经早茶：印度尼西亚据悉考虑年内再次发行熊猫债，融资至多100亿元人民币。
财经早茶：华为据悉从建行、工行等六家中资银行总计获得150亿元人民币境外贷款。
财经早茶：西藏那曲周四晚间发生7级强震，已致至少18人遇难。应急管理部启动国家地震灾害四级应急响应。
财经早茶：受台风蔷琵影响，台湾股市周五休市，台北市停班停课。
第一财经：易方达、华夏、富国、汇添富各以固有资金2亿元认购旗下主动ETF，四家合计拟自购13亿元。摩根此前公告约5亿元。首批主动ETF于10月23日发行。
财新：MiniMax 22日收报160.7港元，跌6.52%，跌破165港元发行价。
华尔街见闻：离岸人民币纽约尾盘报6.6721，较前一交易日上涨。
华尔街见闻援引报道称，DeepSeek本轮融资目标约1000亿元，公司尚未官宣。

chinaImplies.text: If the outbound-investment rules that start on 1 December only rewrite reporting, they leave today's equity tape on the chip selloff.
If the active-ETF subscriptions stay at the announced 13亿元, they are a confidence bid beside the drop, and there is no loan-rate move in them.
If the biotech investment limits become a named list, China ADRs in that sector get a policy price the registration news does not carry.

chinaDivergences: The ChiNext index fell harder than the Shanghai Composite, and Hang Seng Tech fell harder than the Hang Seng, both with the chip complex. Offshore yuan firmed on the breakfast tape while onshore equities were sold. Fund houses announced subscriptions into that drop. The policy lines were an outbound rule, a biotech investment threat, and a disaster response, not a change in loan rates. The mail put the quake response at level four; a separate breakfast line put the regional response at level two, so those grades were not merged.
